scope: Unity Editor only: actual exported bundle loading and temporary SandboxWorld operations. No standalone player, PC HTTP, headset, AI or visual acceptance.
checks: Validation runs only in a Windows Editor fixture targeting Windows
Actual exported manifest matches platform and exact Unity version
Actual bundle bytes match declared size and SHA-256
Unity loads the actual exported AssetBundle
Bundle prefab roots exactly match the typed manifest
Loaded prefab passes runtime component/material limits: matrix-fixture:scifi-props:1.0.0:beacon
Temporary baseline object is created through SandboxWorld
Actual bundle registration preserves baseline scene history and instance
Registered geometry has measured positive bounds
Registered catalog retains exact source provenance
Actual loaded prefab instantiates through the ordinary executor
Placed object retains exact provider pack version and digest
Undo restores the complete baseline scene
Redo restores exact downloaded object ID pose and source
Serialized save clear and restore preserve the exact scene
Conflicting saved bundle digest is rejected without changing the scene
